caption:
Comment “VIBE” and I’ll send you all four 🛠️

Before you vibe code another app with Claude Code, install these 4 plugins:

1. Ponytail makes Claude write the least code that actually works. In the author’s own test (Haiku 4.5, 12 tasks) that was about 54% less code and about 22% fewer tokens
2. OmniRoute is one free gateway that plugs Claude Code into about 150 AI providers with free tiers. Hit a limit and it switches to another model automatically
3. Graphify turns your whole codebase into a knowledge graph, so your agent looks things up instead of re-reading every file
4. Agent Skills from Addy Osmani, a former director at Google. 25 skills for planning, building, testing, reviewing and shipping that kick in on their own at the right stage

Honest note: Ponytail’s numbers are the author’s benchmark on one model, and its README says cost can go up on some models. Test it on your own work.
